_comment: Timing and behaviour. All times UTC. You should not need to touch this.

polling._comment: The shop rotates once daily at 00:00 UTC, and the API sits behind a 30-min cache. So we burst around the rotation and idle the rest of the day.
polling._race_comment: Each language variant has an independently staggered 30-min cache. Racing 2 of them roughly halves worst-case staleness. Set to ["en"] to be maximally light on the API.

notifications._repeat_comment: true = remind you once per shop day for as long as an item stays in the shop. false = alert only once, when it first appears.
notifications._reminder_at_comment: When the DAILY REMINDER may go out, UTC. The shop rotates at 00:00 UTC, which is the middle of the night in many timezones - set e.g. '09:00' to get the daily nudge at a sensible hour instead. A brand-new appearance always alerts immediately and ignores this.
notifications._cooldown_comment: Anti-flap guard. Racing language variants can briefly disagree about the shop, which could otherwise bounce an item absent->present->absent. 1h absorbs that and can never block a real return, since the shop rotates only once every 24h. State loss is already handled by first-run seeding, not by this.
